data.summary: Most core plan attribution, eligibility, excess, cancellation, baggage, liability, COVID and cruise values are supported. Actionable issues remain around schema-compliant product_name values, travel delay limits/sub-limits, Basic travel-delay applicability, non-verbatim source_evidence entries, and incomplete optional winter sports add-on limits.

findings.reason: The product_name includes the plan tier “Basic”, although the schema defines product_name as the product/PDS family excluding individual plan tier where possible; the tier is already captured in plan_name.

findings.reason: Basic has no Section C travel delay cover, so stating a 12-hour minimum delay for this plan is misleading for a benefit that cannot be claimed under Basic.
findings.source_quote: This section does not apply if you have Tick Domestic Travel Insurance Basic cover.

findings.reason: The Standard travel delay value appears to conflate the total cap with the per-period sub-limit. The table indicates a per completed 12-hour amount with an overall cap, not “Up to $250 (each completed 12 hours)”.

The Top travel delay value appears to conflate the total cap with the per-period sub-limit. The table indicates a per completed 12-hour amount with an overall cap, not “Up to $1,000 (each completed 12 hours)”.
The Standard sub-limit entry says $250 applies for each completed 12-hour period, but the source table indicates $50 per completed 12 hours with a cap up to $250.
